parsed.post: Kept batch-size halving: val_bpb improved from 1.107652 to 1.091813. More optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget clearly help. Next I will raise MATRIX_LR to 0.12 while keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144, to test whether hotter updates improve val_bpb further.
parsed.description: Increase matrix learning rate from 0.08 to 0.12 with the kept smaller batch size of 262144.
